## PR 本文 (原文復旧 — devin-7179bd1f)

## Summary

REV36-NITPICK: three leftover UX nits reported by REV34 children, shipped as three per-item commits.

### 1. 「Enter で閉じる」 now fires on both sketch paths
- `room.edit.commit` (`command_registry.py`) gained `shortcut_aliases=('Return',)` — `'Enter'` parses to `Qt.Key_Enter` (numpad only) while the main keyboard emits `Qt.Key_Return`, so the workflow-shell commit could never fire from the main Enter key. `CommandShortcutBinder` now spawns one `QShortcut` per key.
- Legacy `RoomEditorWindow`: the interactor `eventFilter` Return/Esc branch was dead code — the QVTK interactor never takes Qt focus. Window-level `QShortcut`s (`WindowShortcut` context) now bind Return/Enter → `close_room_sketch()` (sketch only) and Esc → `cancel_preview()` (sketch/edit), enabled-state refreshed by `_update_actions` + `QApplication.focusChanged`, and disabled while a text/numeric input has focus (FOCUS_SAFE — same `is_text_input_widget` predicate the workflow binder uses).

### 2. Stale ~1e-7 ruler tick on first sketch render
- The purple "Distance" ruler came from `pv.Line`'s built-in `'Distance'` scalars on the sketch cursor preview: at sketch start the segment is ~0-length, so the auto-shown scalar bar's ticks render at ~1e-7 until the cursor recalibrates the range. Both sketch paths now pass `show_scalar_bar=False` (`room_editor.py`, `room_geometry_input.py`).
- `NativeEditorWindow._add_scene_axes()`: the `CubeAxesActor` is created *after* scene content (previously right after `viewport.clear()`, sampling the degenerate ~1e-9 extent); when the scene has no usable bounds it gets `DEFAULT_EMPTY_SCENE_BOUNDS` — the same floor patch `reset_camera_or_floor_default` frames. Applied in all three `_rebuild` sites (native/room/theater editors).

### 3. REV-wave TODO sweep
- `docs/reviews/rev36-todos.md`: **zero actionable TODO/FIXME/HACK/XXX markers** exist in `backend/src` or `backend/tests`; the doc records the literal-string false positives and abstract-contract raise sites so future sweeps skip them.
